label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf's Funding Uncertain
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau revealed that Saudi Arabia’s PIF will end LIV Golf funding after 2026, but he is pushing a new team-golf business plan to secure $250–$350 million in fresh investment and keep LIV alive.

items.headline: Clark Withdraws From Charles Schwab
items.text: Wyndham Clark withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge, joining Brooks Koepka in pulling out before the tournament begins, reducing star power at Colonial.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s Major Struggles Continue
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau missed cuts at both the Masters and PGA in 2026 as he tries to regain form amid LIV Golf’s financial uncertainty.
